_comment: 英文覆盖层：按索引对齐 foods/scenes/unis 的中文条目（本文件数组顺序必须与 zh 文件一致）。覆盖 desc/history 叙述字段；名称用各条目已有的 en 字段。
history: Lhasa grew around the Jokhang Temple 1,300 years ago — 'first there was the Jokhang, then came Lhasa'. The Potala Palace is the highest palace complex on earth, World Heritage since 1994. With 3,000+ sunshine hours a year it is the 'City of Sunlight'. Prayer wheels, butter tea and pilgrims on their long prostrations paint the spiritual scene of the Roof of the World.
importance: Capital of Tibet · City of Sunlight · Holy city
foods: Salty butter tea with tsampa — highland energy.
Roasted-barley flour kneaded into balls — the Tibetan staple.
Yak noodle soup in a sweet-tea house.
Lhasa's sweet milk tea, black-tea and milk.
Yak hotpot in clear highland broth.
Tibetan cold jelly noodles with chili powder.
scenes: The world's highest palace — the Red and White palaces above the city.
Center of Tibetan Buddhism, home of the Jowo 12-year-old Buddha statue.
The Barkhor kora — the old pilgrim circuit around the old town.
Sera Monastery's debating courtyard thunders with claps.
Norbulingka, the summer palace — a garden of treasures.
Drepung — one of the world's largest monasteries, where the Shoton thangka unfurls.
Namtso, the holy 'Heavenly Lake' under Nyenchen Tanglha snow peaks.
The best spot to photograph the Potala's reflection.
